title: Targets presence is decided by 'is not None', never by truthiness
answers: why does evaluate ignore my empty targets list
targets=[] passed to evaluate gives no length error
how should optional targets be checked in mlflow evaluation dataset conversion
numpy array targets ambiguous truth value in evaluation
body:
Invariant: in convert_data_to_mlflow_dataset, whether targets are present is decided by `targets is not None`, never by truthiness of `targets`.
Enforced at mlflow/data/evaluation_dataset.py:convert_data_to_mlflow_dataset, where `np.array(targets) if targets is not None else None` is the only place targets are normalized for list input.
What breaks if skipped: a truthiness check raises on multi-element NumPy arrays, and it silently converts explicit empty targets to None, which hides the length mismatch that standard validation should report.
Constraints: explicit empty targets must reach the standard length validation. tests/data/test_evaluation_dataset.py:test_convert_list_data_with_empty_targets_uses_standard_validation expects a 'same length' MlflowException from to_evaluation_dataset().
applies: Any code in mlflow/data that normalizes optional targets or other optional array inputs before building an evaluation dataset.
says: Model evaluation silently ignores empty target lists instead of reporting a length mismatch error.
Providing an empty list of targets during evaluation fails to trigger dataset length validation.
Evaluating a model with an array of targets crashes with an ambiguous truth error.
Ensure evaluation dataset creation treats empty targets as present to enforce length matching.
Empty target lists in model evaluation should produce a mismatched length validation error.
search: In mlflow/data/evaluation_dataset.py:convert_data_to_mlflow_dataset, normalize optional targets using targets is not None rather than truthiness evaluation. Checking truthiness raises ambiguous truth value errors on multi-element NumPy arrays and silently converts empty lists to None, bypassing length validation. Explicit empty targets must reach standard length validation as tested in tests/data/test_evaluation_dataset.py:test_convert_list_data_with_empty_targets_uses_standard_validation.
